item.title: WONDER MAN Was At Risk Of Becoming A Tax Write-Off During 2023's Hollywood Strikes
item.description: Wonder Man showrunner Andrew Guest has revealed how 2023's Hollywood strikes impacted the MCU+ series, explaining that "it could have been a tax write-off for Disney."

item.title: AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Rumor: LANTERNS Star Aaron Pierre Among Those Eyed For MCU's New Black Panther
item.description: A new Avengers: Secret Wars rumour reveals that Lanterns star Aaron Pierre is among those being eyed by Marvel Studios to play the MCU's new T'Challa/Black Panther.

item.title: AVENGERS: INFINITY WAR Controversy Had A Bigger Impact On Chris Pratt Than You Might Expect
item.description: Guardians of the Galaxy star Chris Pratt admits that the controversy surrounding Star-Lord's actions in Avengers: Infinity War had a bigger-than-expected impact on him.

item.title: THE ODYSSEY TV Spot Reveals That Rapper Travis Scott Has Joined The Cast In An Unexpected Role
item.description: A new TV spot for The Odyssey has been released, and it confirms that rapper Travis Scott has joined the cast to recite the story of Odysseus's infiltration of the city of Troy.

item.title: X-MEN: 5 Eras Of Comic Book Storytelling That Could Inspire Marvel Studios' Reboot
item.description: With Marvel Studios gearing up to reboot the X-Men franchise with Thunderbolts* filmmaker Jake Schreier, there are some specific periods of comic book storytelling that could be key sources of inspiration.

item.title: PONIES Stars Nicholas Podany & Vic Michaelis On That Massive Twist, Car Chases, Spy Life & More! (Exclusive)
item.description: With PONIES, starring Emilia Clarke and Haley Lu Richardson, now streaming on Peacock, we recently sat down with series regulars Nicholas Podany and Vic Michaelis to get more insight on that massive twist!

item.title: AVENGERS: SECRET WARS Rumor Reveals Plans For Iconic Infinity War Villain To Return - SPOILERS
item.description: A new Avengers: Secret Wars rumour has revealed that the Infinity Saga's most iconic villain is set to return and terrorise the Multiverse's Mightiest Heroes in the 2027 movie.

item.title: THE STRANGERS - CHAPTER 3 Interview: Madelaine Petsch On Horror Finale And Poison Ivy Fan Casts (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about her role in The Strangers - Chapter 3, Madelaine Petsch (Riverdale) reaffirms that playing iconic Batman villain Poison Ivy remains a dream role.

item.title: Sam Raimi's DARKMAN Reboot Reportedly Moving Forward With DON'T MOVE Filmmakers
item.description: Sam Raimi has been promising Darkman fans an update on the reboot for years, but the movie is finally taking shape with the addition of Don't Move helmers, Brian Netto and Adam Schindler.

item.title: MADAME WEB Star Sydney Sweeney May Face Legal Trouble For...Hanging Bras From Hollywood Sign
item.description: Footage of The Housemaid star Sydney Sweeney hanging her bras from the iconic Hollywood sign in Los Angeles could land the actress in trouble with authorities in Los Angeles.
